wiki.title: Kyle Brown (politician)
wiki.extract: Kyle Brown is an American politician serving as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives from the 12th district since his appointment in 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Brown was previously a member of the Louisville City Council.
